scientific_question: Under what mate-limited census does a genetically favored shift to prior selfing reduce group viable-seed output, and does it reduce finite persistence relative to frozen expression?
model_independence: Independent one-locus diploid ovule-binomial model with seed-level draws and uniform cap lottery, not Model3 Poisson recruitment or Model3 three-locus genetic architecture.

reproductive_kernel.father: uniform different adult for successful outcross; no pollen discount
reproductive_kernel.genome: single diploid 0/1-locus, expressed a=(allele1+allele2)/2 in heritable arm; frozen arm expresses founder mean for all adult genotypes but still segregates alleles
reproductive_kernel.inheritance: each selfed offspring inherits two independently drawn homologs from the same mother; each outcross offspring inherits one maternal and one paternal homolog
reproductive_kernel.density: sample each of two ovules per mother by multinomial; retain at most K viable embryos by uniform lottery; no immigration/mutation/adult survival

algebra.local_prior_beta: ovules*phi*(v-q_eff/2)>0 at all stated q,N in symmetric resident no pollen discount
algebra.abundant_q_0_8_boundary: with A=1,v=.6, qeff(n=4)=.6, group slope positive for N<=3, zero at N=4, negative for N>=5
algebra.male_accounting: paternal rare-mutant slope 0 at fixed resident mating state; do not confuse zero paternal marginal effect with zero paternal contribution
algebra.discovery_status: Known classic selfing transmission advantage; mathematical control not claim of original novel evolutionary-suicide law

analysis.primary: P(N80>0|heritable)-P(N80>0|frozen_expression) at prior, q=.8, K=8, unconditional across 128 independently seeded demographic trajectories
analysis.secondary: All other seven timing/q/K settings and N20 persistence, survivor-only allele means with extinct values undefined
analysis.interval: paired exclusive-event Bonferroni/Clopper-Pearson conservative 95% interval; ±.05 practical threshold; no across-cell confirmatory inference
analysis.stop: exactly 128 seeds per all eight settings and two expression modes; all outcomes retained

limits: Synthetic binomial diploid alternative, not other independently calibrated natural island population
Expression freeze does not freeze alleles or drift; a genetic-development intervention changes initial individual expression distribution
Analytic sign opposition intentionally parameter-constructed, so not a novel biological discovery
No deleterious-mutation accumulation, no pollen-discount evolution, no rare phenotype-invasion path guaranteed
Stochastic replications are demographic draws from one alternative kernel, not independent island systems
preregistration_parameter_reason: At N=8, q=.8, source a=.375, expected viable seeds per adult=2*.9*(.625*.7+.375*.6)=1.1925 >1, to avoid forcing immediate demographic extinction by design; q=.4 source mean yields <1, high assurance approaches 1.08. This was set from algebra only, before any stochastic outcome.
